# Rainbowfern (Astrid Lapinski)
> Astrid Lapinski is a software architect and the founder of Rainbowfern, a one-person consulting practice in northwest Philadelphia. Services: Codebase Map, Small-business systems, Mentoring and coaching, Unstuck sessions.
